The '''AI-4 droid brain''' was a model of [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. The AI-4 was installed in [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries']] [[Agonizer-6 nerve disruptor]]. A fully-functional [[Droid/Legends|droid]] brain with a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]], [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio sensors]], and an integrated [[Dataport/Legends|dataport]]. The AI-4 did not possess an elaborate [[Personality matrix/Legends|personality matrix]], instead being coldly impersonal and focused on its assigned duties.<ref name="EGWT" />
